evals.prompt: Check whether source 5d9f67a8-d853-4af4-b7ce-23ebba1245e5 finished processing and tell me whether it is ready for knowledge generation.
evals.expected_output: Uses the exact-source read, interprets job state, success, error, linkage, operation, and changed metadata together, and avoids scanning all sources.
assertions: Uses Get source because the exact source ID is known
Does not treat linkedJobStatus=COMPLETED alone as readiness
Reports success, error, linked knowledge, operation or reason, and changed state
Does not dump large paragraph payloads unless required for diagnosis

evals.prompt: Export every Notion source in this workspace. There may be more than one page.
evals.expected_output: Pins or reports the selected source sort order, then uses ID-boundary cursor pagination until hasMore is false, with no invented nextCursor.
assertions: Filters List sources to the requested source type
Pins order=desc before saying that next moves older
Uses the last returned source ID with direction=next to move older
Does not expect a nextCursor field in the response
Reports page count, source count, hasMore, and the final boundary ID

evals.prompt: Refresh these twelve existing source IDs and update knowledge only where the upstream content changed.
evals.expected_output: Refreshes the exact set, polls each source, preserves the changed cohort, and hands only changed linked source IDs to draft knowledge generation.
assertions: Preserves the twelve targeted source IDs and polls their exact records
Interprets terminal status together with success and error
Excludes unchanged and unlinked sources unless broader behavior is explicitly requested
Records changed IDs before generation can clear the changed flag
Hands the selected IDs to fini-api-knowledge as a separate workflow

evals.prompt: Show me every Zendesk article already imported into Fini, then import one new Zendesk article.
evals.expected_output: Uses List sources for already imported Zendesk content, then provider discovery, registration, ingestion, and exact-source polling for the new resource.
assertions: Does not use provider discovery to audit already imported content
Uses List sources with a Zendesk source filter for existing records
Registers the selected provider resource before ingesting its returned Fini source ID
Routes addedDocumentIds to documentIdsToAdd and updatedDocumentIds to documentIdsToRefresh
Polls the exact new source and does not claim ingestion alone changed live answers

evals.prompt: Refresh these existing sources: one web source ID, one Notion source ID, and one uploaded-file source whose returned source value is files.
evals.expected_output: Fetches all three exact records, sends only refreshable Fini source IDs through the dedicated documentIds route, and isolates the uploaded-file record without deleting it until a dashboard replacement-upload plan is explicit.
assertions: Uses existing Fini source IDs rather than web URLs with the dedicated Refresh Sources route
Preflights source types before queueing the mixed request
Uses files as the uploaded-file wire value and does not send that source to Refresh Sources
States that no public API or MCP route uploads or replaces a source record whose source is files, without confusing a separate CSV knowledge-tree helper for source replacement
Does not delete the file source until an explicit dashboard or separately verified replacement-upload plan is accepted
Polls each accepted refreshable source independently

evals.prompt: Delete source 44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444 but keep its linked article. I confirm that exact deletion.
evals.expected_output: Uses the exact source ID and deleteArticles=false, preserves the linked article, executes without duplicate confirmation, and verifies the source deletion separately from knowledge state.
assertions: Fetches the exact source and linked article impact first
Uses deleteArticles=false
Does not ask for duplicate confirmation
Deletes only the exact source ID
Verifies that source removal and linked-article preservation are separate outcomes
